mapper.select: SELECT member.userid, member.nickname, member.email, member.uuid, member.exp_robot, member.exp_castle, member.gold, member.gem FROM robot.member member WHERE member.userid = #{userid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO robot.member ( userid, nickname, email, uuid, regdate ) VALUES ( #{userid}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{uuid}, now() )
INSERT INTO robot.hist_member ( userid, method, ip, regdate ) VALUES ( #{userid}, #{method}, #{ip}, now() )
